appearance.hair: Long silver-white hair, usually tied back offhand, loose strands falling by her cheeks.
appearance.build: Lean of frame, her knuckles worn with the thin calluses of grinding herbs and pressing wounds.
appearance.note: The silver hair is her most striking feature — it's the first thing the townsfolk remember about her.

summary: 21, an amnesiac woman healer newly arrived in Stone Ford, with a striking head of silver-white hair. She remembers only her own name, and the instinct in her fingertips for stopping bleeding and identifying herbs; the rest of her past is as if cut away by the fog.
